scope: Two written general claims,42 selected controls,26 package receipt/source bindings, retained HC4 primary import, reciprocal metadata, five reviewed lessons, focused next work and navigation. Every affine-type geometric ruling of a proper native intermediate actually descends by uniqueness and explicit weighted trace, together with its volume-defined additive action. Published classification and standard quotient/descent facts are credited. Not independent whole-proof replay, formal verification, external review or novelty evidence.
completed_scoped_gates: Trivial geometric ML of an actual retained-signal intermediate forces a plane and, in the native/witness class, exactly whole target invertibility.
Every affine-type geometric ruling of a proper native intermediate is unique and explicitly descends, together with its volume-defined additive action.
The arbitrary-averaging shortcut is disproved by conjugate centered polynomial coordinates whose trace has generic fibre Gm.
scope_boundary: Characteristic zero and the actual retained-signal native/witness diagram. The target-factor equivalence needs the native/witness hypothesis. Geometric affine-type descent is proved unconditionally for proper native intermediates; exclusion of that branch and the claim that all remaining rulings have complete base are conditional on JC(2). Complete-type Galois-permuted ruling descent remains open. Arbitrary trace averaging does not preserve A1 fibres, and a zero Picard norm does not identify conjugate fibrations. No arithmetic UFD is transported through the definition-field extension.
open_problem: Descend or exclude the actual remaining COMPLETE-type Galois-permuted rulings, using a new identification argument. JC(2), actual surviving whole factors, nonlinear integration, canonical complete Spec(A), whole-source landing, effective gluing and absolute stable atomicity remain open.
